fields.System.Title: OUT-208 — Prefer fewer pick locations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker, I want an order line satisfied from as few locations as possible, so that
I make one stop instead of four for the same units.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a line that could be filled from one location or several, then the single
  • location is chosen.
  • - Given several single-location candidates, then a pick face is preferred over bulk.
  • - Given FEFO and location preference conflict, then FEFO wins for expiry-tracked
  • products and the rule is documented.
  • - Given no single location suffices, then the fewest locations are chosen.
  • - Given the change, then average pick locations per order line is measurable before and
  • after.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | allocation, stock_balance |
| Risks | Location preference quietly overriding FEFO ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
